newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHKP says all 713 units at Tsing Yi sold.
newsitem.headline: SHKP says all 713 units at Tsing Yi sold.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Tuesday all 713 units in the first phase of its Villa Esplanada residential property development at Tsing Yi in the New Territories were sold on Sunday.
"All of the units have been sold out," a spokeswoman said.
Sun Hung Kai Properties said 160 units were initially offered at HK$6,300 to HK$7,257 per square foot. The number of flats on offer was later raised to 713.
China Resources Enterprise Ltd has a 55 percent stake in the development, while Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and Sun Hung Kai Properties each hold 22.5 percent.
